info.name: Node AI RAG Service & Gemini Chatbot
info.description:
# 🤖 Node AI RAG Microservice & Gemini Chatbot

Official Postman Collection for the **Node AI RAG Microservice** (`https://sih2026-86kl.onrender.com`) and Spring Boot Gateway endpoints.

### 🚀 Base URLs:
- **Direct Node AI RAG Service**: `https://sih2026-86kl.onrender.com`
- **Spring Boot Gateway (Local)**: `http://localhost:8080/api/officer/tenders`
- **Spring Boot Gateway (Production)**: `https://sih2026-83r4.onrender.com/api/officer/tenders`

### 🧠 Vector & AI Stack:
- **Vector Database**: PostgreSQL with `pgvector` (Neon DB)
- **Embeddings**: Google Gemini `text-embedding-004` (768 dimensions)
- **LLM Reasoning**: Google Gemini 1.5 Pro / Flash with source citations
